arStrings.szText: The first direct damage you deal to an enemy is a guaranteed Critical Strike. When a {c_important}Marksman{/c} Skill first Critically Strikes, it gains {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|x%|]{/c} increased damage, and you gain {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} {c_important}{u}Overpower{/u}{/c}. This can stack up to {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} over your Maximum {c_important}{u}Overpower{/u}{/c}.
